title: Peas Wet: modeled ₹360/qtl left, Naraingarh → Ganaur
summary: January 2021: reported peas Wet prices at Naraingarh and Ganaur imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 88% of 25 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹360 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 152 same-variety market pairs screened for peas Wet in January 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Ganaur report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2021
scenes.caption: Naraingarh (Haryana) and Ganaur (Haryana) both reported peas Wet prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 25 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Naraingarh reported a median ₹1,200 per quintal. Ganaur reported a median ₹1,800 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹500/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹500 per quintal, and Ganaur was dearer on 96% of days.

scenes.headline: 172 km by road
scenes.caption: 172 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹37/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹305 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹211 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Ganaur report, the rule selects 20 of 23 modeled shipping days. 17 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹360 per quintal (₹264 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Peas Wet route from Naraingarh to Ganaur was positive on 88% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹36,000, or ₹26,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Peas Wet: modeled ₹434/qtl left, Kathua → Rajouri (F&V)
summary: December 2021: reported peas Wet prices at Kathua and Rajouri (F&V) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 79% of 14 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹434 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 58 same-variety market pairs screened for peas Wet in December 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Rajouri (F&V) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹750/qtl

scenes.headline: After modeled costs

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
